# Button

The command button.

`LL.Button` · Components · Actions & input

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Button />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Button"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Feedback (Foundations · Motion): hover fades a layer in over duration-fast — the gilt edge, or the solid fill 6% brighter; a press sinks the Button 1px at once and releases over duration-fast. Under reduced motion both happen at once.

## Props (ButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'solid' \| 'quiet' \| 'danger' \| 'link'` | primary: an engraved rectangle with a line-strong edge (default); solid: gilt fill, one per screen; quiet: text only; danger: destructive; link: gilt text fo… |
| `size` | `'md' \| 'sm'` | Omit to follow the region's density (44, 40 or 32px). md pins Standard (40px), sm pins Compact (32px). |
| `density` | `'comfortable' \| 'standard' \| 'compact'` |  |
| `hotkey` | `string` | Key cap shown after the label, and aria-keyshortcuts. Wire the key yourself. |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |
| `state` | `'available' \| 'unavailable' \| 'locked' \| 'restricted' \| 'insufficient' \| 'cooldown' \| 'pending'` | Standards · States. Blocked — unavailable, locked (a dashed edge), restricted, insufficient, cooldown: the label in ink-muted, no hover or press, still focus… |
| `reason` | `string` | Why it is blocked: "Not while in a dungeon"; for locked, how it unlocks: "Unlocks at level 20"; for restricted, who may. |
| `shortfall` | `{ amount: number; name: string }[]` | insufficient: what is missing. Becomes "Short by 250 Cinders and 40 Essence Dust". |
| `remaining` | `number` | cooldown: seconds left. Becomes "Ready in 4m 12s", read as "Ready in 4 minutes 12 seconds". |
| `pendingLabel` | `React.ReactNode` | The progressive label while pending: "Claiming…". Give it always, so the Button keeps room for it and nothing shifts. |

_Also accepts: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>._
